title: Audit (no new κ): side-condition coverage of the pending T74 outer at #2044 — 554 written conditions, none load-bearing false; or-True and g² review items resolved
body:
**Status: adversarial audit and research note. No counterexample was found. There is no new κ and no change to the frontier, and this does not claim the audited arguments are proved.**

## Question

The pending T74 family claims conditional κ = 0.0016797549561255445…, which is +0.43% over the selected record. The latest head is #2044 `322949a5`. Its final parameter point puts β and ε within 10⁻³⁰⁰¹⁰ of 1, but many inherited PR1673 notes were written at β ≈ 0.09.

The ledger only checks what it encodes. So the audit asks: is every asymptotic side condition written in the 28 notes encoded and true at that point, true there for an elementary reason, or explicitly superseded? "Side condition" covers exponent inequalities, "o(p)", "fits the record" and "eventually". Maintainer reviews of #1673, #1758, #1876 and #1928 leave these parameter-inequality interfaces open.

## Result

| class | count |
|---|---:|
| COVERED (ledger check or recorded identity) | 262 |
| AUTO_TRUE (elementary) | 53 |
| OBSOLETE (explicitly superseded, file:line cited) | 113 |
| STALE_TEXT_ONLY | 64 |
| NON_EXPONENT (listed, not assessed) | 58 |
| FALSE_AT_POINT (all non-load-bearing) | 3 |
| UNCOVERED_TRUE | 1 |

**No load-bearing side condition is false at the #2044 point.**
- Every condition that fails there was explicitly superseded by a later note: the linear gauge, `2β<1`, `β<1−ε`, the g-factor union row, union density and `θ ≥ 1/(4d)`. Each of these held at PR1673's own point.
- The smallest margins are 10⁻³⁰⁰²² to 6·10⁻³⁰⁰¹⁰. They hold only *eventually*, which suffices for an asymptotic exponent but is not a cutoff.

**Defects found. None changes κ.**
1. `FINE-PADDING-COMPOSITION.md:37` claims all non-main margins are ≥ 10⁻³⁰⁰¹⁰. This is false: the router row is 5.03·10⁻³⁰⁰¹¹.
2. `FINE-PADDING-COMPOSITION.md:38` has a false aside about ξ being free.
3. `HALO-THEOREM.md:205` asserts `K₀² = o(p)`, which is false at the point. The theorem's explicit-metadata branch holds, but no final note records that it is the branch used.
4. The PR1786 p¹⁰ umbrella exponent is true, but no ledger row ties it to `THETA_POWER`.
5. Stale digits: ξ = 0.90792965… appears where the pinned value is 0.90792975…, and 62 other stale numbers remain.

Other observations:
- The offline fine-θ precision term a/(4θ) = Θ(p² log p) is handled only in PR1786 §3, not by any ledger row.
- ζ is unused by every ledger formula.
- The removals of `β<1−ε`, `g<√B` and union sparsity are load-bearing.

**Open review items, both resolved.**
- **#1876/#1897 `or True` guard.** Line 23 has both sign errors and would fail if made live. Nothing depends on it: the proof's shifts use live assertions, and neither the ledger nor `run_outer.py` uses it. A second vacuous `or True` sits at `outer/struct_check.py:130`.
- **GAUGEFREE §7, "no other g² per record".** No active step charges g² to one record. Every hit is superseded and rejected by a ledger control, apart from the HALO option in defect 3.

## Relation to concurrent work

philippeVV published closely related checks on the same head. They are #1897 and #2044 comments with fork commits `a3c40a6f`, `e6bc8393`, `bc4ed55b`, `76af2562` and `d1e01310`, posted 2026-10-14 19:40 UTC to 2026-10-15 00:46 UTC. They include:
- the broad-shift / `or True` reconciliation and the 3b₀θB correction;
- an exact knockout showing the lift rests on PR1673's removal of the Vd row;
- a PR1673 fusion cost census, including the same HALO finding;
- the H-call and layout-contract analyses;
- the CRLF and stage-E issues.

That work has priority on those points, and this PR independently corroborates them. The overlap helper does not index PR comments, so this audit's overlap check missed them. This PR adds:
- a machine-checkable inventory of *all* written side conditions in all 28 notes (outer, PR1758 and PR1786 notes included), mapped to the 62 ledger checks;
- a registered exact verifier;
- findings 1, 2, 4 and 5, the offline-precision and ζ observations, `struct_check.py:130`, and the g² sweep table.

It does not repeat the knockout, the census or the release-path findings.

## Verification

- **Agents:**
  - Four independent extractors cover the 28 notes.
  - An exact ledger re-evaluation covers 62 checks and 18 controls.
  - Every flagged item was checked by two agents, one trying to refute it and one re-deriving it.
  - A separate agent independently re-checked a seeded sample of 28 non-flagged classifications. It agreed on 27; the mistranslation it found, together with a second instance of the same error, is corrected and does not change any truth value.
  - All 38 verdicts are recorded in `INVENTORY.json`.
- **`verify.py`:**
  - rebuilds the final point from one pinned 30,000-digit rational plus closed forms;
  - evaluates the 133 keys at 4 points with an AST-whitelisted exact evaluator;
  - enforces the classification rules;
  - recomputes 49 ledger checks and 7 controls;
  - runs 14 negative controls (16 with `--source-root`).
- **`review_items.py`:** exact Laurent-polynomial certificates and final-point exponent checks. It runs 88 checks by default; with `--source-root` it runs 122, re-checking 108 citations.

## Reproduce

From the repository root, Python 3.10+ standard library only, about 35 s:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/t74-side-condition-coverage-audit/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/t74-side-condition-coverage-audit/review_items.py
```

The last lines should begin `PASS_T74_SIDE_CONDITION_COVERAGE conditions=554 keys=133 covered=262 … load_bearing_false=0` and `PASS_T74_REVIEW_ITEMS checks=88 mode=default …`.

To check against the audited sources, export #2044 head `322949a5` and pass `--source-root DIR` to both scripts. This re-hashes 32 files and locates every quote.

Checks run locally:
- The default and source-root modes of both scripts pass on CPython 3.14.4.
- `research_package.py --check-only` gives `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`.
- The 65 `test_research_*.py` tests pass.
- The registered Python 3.12 replay was **not** run (3.12 is not installed); the scripts parse under the 3.10 grammar.

## Scope

- **Checked:** the *written* side conditions and their exact truth at the point.
- **Not checked:**
  - the arguments themselves (accretive Toeplitz theorem, SHALLOW-TOEPLITZ, union-schedule correctness, halo/locality, Trudgian step);
  - the all-size, hosting and precision/tape interfaces;
  - supplier admission;
  - code-only assumptions.
- **Extraction limits:** extraction is exhaustive over the prose, but it is model reading checked by verifiers, so a condition no extractor recognised is not covered.
- **Head:** the inventory is pinned to `322949a5`. #2161 and #2180 would need their final point re-substituted.
